notes: Rule (cite.py --check 11.4.4 "the class containing the factory object inherits a class whose factory object implements int-1" -> OK §11.4.4 2) c)): factory implements int-1 when a) its own IMPLEMENTS names it, b) it implements an interface inheriting int-1, c) its class inherits a class whose factory implements int-1. ImplementsClosure(cls, factory:true) walks the Base chain (leg c) collecting FactoryImplements (leg a) and recursively each interface's Inherits (leg b); OoBinder's SET format 5 test (~l.1129) consults the same closure; the emitter gives each emitted half its closure and the interface emits its INHERITS as C# bases. Probes: p6 leg b) - FACTORY IMPLEMENTS FPJ, FPJ INHERITS FPI, a ref typed FPI accepts the factory object and dispatches (J-F 0042); p5 leg c) - FPC with no IMPLEMENTS inherits FPB whose FACTORY IMPLEMENTS FPI; SET S(FPI) TO FPC accepted and INVOKE dispatches FPC's OVERRIDE (CHILD-F 0042) at 2002/2014/2023; leg a) in oo_implements_repeated; the negative direction (factory not implementing) is rejected COBOL0867 (p1/p8; negatives pb451-classname-sender-factory-not-implements, pb451-self-sender-factory-not-implements).
